name: Sarah Smith Fund
identity_check: Confirmed as sarahsmith.fund, a solo-GP pre-seed and seed fund led by Sarah Smith (ex-Bain Capital Ventures per TechCrunch coverage), focused on the Stanford ecosystem; site portfolio includes Casca and TrueMeter. Professional facts only. Not any other person named Sarah Smith.

pages.title: Sarah Smith launches $16M fund, says AI can 'unlock' so much for solo GPs like herself
TrueMeter raises $4 million in seed round

thesis_text.value: Backs intensely driven founder CEOs early, pairing capital with people-operations support, with a Stanford-ecosystem focus and fast solo-GP decisions.

funds.name: Sarah Smith Fund I
funds.snippet: announced Thursday the final closing of a $16 million Fund I.

company.name: TrueMeter
company.description: AI platform helping multi-location businesses such as restaurants and retailers cut energy costs through rate optimisation, consolidated billing and operational insights.

rounds.snippet: The round was led by Ulu Ventures, with participation from Pear VC, e2.vc, RiverPark Ventures, Flex Capital, Sarah Smith Fund

open_items: HQ not stated for the fund; the site says the GP lives in Menlo Park (personal, not recorded as firm HQ) and TechCrunch says the fund is 'doubling down on Stanford campus'. Not recorded.

Only 1 round recorded. Casca Series A (Aug 2025, Canapi lead) is tagged to the fund by FinTech Global but the article text does not list it; Casca $3.9M pre-seed (Feb 2024) seen on an aggregator only. The site lists 50 portfolio companies (Casca, Rowspace, Pika, Skyfire and others) but no round pages naming the fund were found.
Round date is month precision (September 2025); aggregators vary 09-01 to 09-11. Business Wire release returned 403.
Fund close date 2025-07-10 inferred: TechCrunch (2025-07-11) says 'announced Thursday'. Lead list said 2025-07-10. LPs named by TechCrunch: Pear VC, Ulu Ventures, Verdis Investment Management.
Application process not described on the site; check size recorded as $250K+ (minimum only).
